title: Deterministic presentation policy and observation integration
objective: Encode D0-D3 disclosure precedence as deterministic facts and decisions, then apply it to retained observations without weakening evidence or redaction.
requirements: Failures, partial results, denials, timeouts, integrity errors, warnings, side effects, plan gates, and decisions have enforceable minimum depth.
User inspect/full/audit/pin intents are reversible and cannot bypass redaction.
Unknown risk fails closed for aggregation and unknown tools use a safe fallback.
Stored evidence remains exact while display projections are bounded and redacted.
write_scope: tui presentation policy and observation projection

acceptance.criterion: Priority table covers P0-P10 and D0 is projection-owned.
D3 display redaction does not mutate exact retained evidence.
Restored observations deterministically recompute missing presentation data.

remaining_risks: New outcome or risk enums must be added to policy table tests before renderer use.

result.summary: Pure policy decisions now drive observation disclosure, surfaces, reasons, aggregation eligibility, and redaction.
